Midterm 2 is now available as a released exam for review and study.

This is the student version of the exam used on **Monday, April 20, 2026**. It covers the core ideas from Module 2: the Sun and stellar fusion, parallax and stellar distances, the Hertzsprung-Russell diagram, binary stars and stellar masses, star formation, stellar evolution, and how stars die — including white dwarfs, neutron stars, and black holes.

## How to Use This Well

Use the released exam as a self-check, not just an answer hunt.

1. Try the exam first under realistic conditions.
2. Use the equation sheet, but not your notes.
3. Check your reasoning with the [solutions page](midterm-2-solutions.qmd).
4. Revisit the Module 2 readings for any concept that still feels shaky.
